svg.aria-label: Isometric drawing of an eight-cavity PET preform injection mold on a two-platen press. The hot half, with its hot runner manifold and cavity plate, is bolted to the fixed platen beside the injection barrel and hopper. The cold half, with eight cores, a stripper plate and split neck ring slides, rides the moving platen on two rails, driven by the clamp cylinder. Each cycle the mold closes and is filled and cooled, then opens; the neck rings strip the preforms off the cores, open, and drop them through the chute in the bed.
